verdict.rationale: GrowthBook exposes a REST API and an official MCP server that lets AI coding tools (Cursor, VS Code, Claude) make authenticated calls with 'Agent Skills' guardrails, which could be scripted into automations, and features like stale-flag detection run automatically. However there is no evidence of scheduled jobs, background workers, or an autonomous agent runtime that executes tasks without a human driving the MCP/API session. Missing for 10: evidence of a background/scheduled automation engine, autonomous trigger execution, or examples of unattended agentic workflows beyond interactive AI-tool integration.
